stories.title: Verstappen Inherits Las Vegas Pole After Antonelli's Engine Penalty

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Antonelli was FASTEST in Las Vegas qualifying (1:33.893) but gets a 5-place penalty for his 6th engine. Verstappen inherits pole. Russell P2. The reigning champion starts P6. Only in F1. #LasVegasGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Las Vegas GP starting grid: Verstappen P1 | Russell P2 | Norris P3 | Hadjar P4. Antonelli starts P6 despite being fastest. Leclerc P11. Hamilton P12. What a race this will be. #LasVegasGP

stories.title: Ferrari Nightmare — Both Leclerc and Hamilton Eliminated in Q2

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Both Ferraris out in Q2. Leclerc qualifies 11th. Hamilton 12th. Ferrari had the worst possible Las Vegas qualifying. Title hopes for Leclerc just got much harder. #LasVegasGP #F1

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Lewis Hamilton's first Las Vegas GP with Ferrari and he qualifies 12th. His title fight vs Russell is now razor thin — 262 to 261 points. Starting from the back doesn't help. #LasVegasGP
